events.text: Tim Russert took over as moderator of Meet the Press.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He took over as moderator of Meet the Press on December 8 , 1991

events.text: Russert remained with the program until his death.
events.subject: self
events.quote: remained with the program until his death on June 13 , 2008

events.text: Meet the Press was the highest-rated program among the Sunday morning talk shows.
events.subject: self
events.quote: By 2006 , Meet the Press was the highest-rated program among the Sunday morning talk shows

events.text: Russert died of a sudden coronary thrombosis.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On June 13 , 2008 , Russert died of a sudden coronary thrombosis

events.text: Tom Brokaw hosted a special edition of Meet the Press dedicated to the life of Russert.
events.subject: other
events.quote: Tom Brokaw hosted a special edition of Meet the Press dedicated to the life of Russert on June 15 , 2011
